name: Night Drive
source:
Night drive is a furry visual novel set in Fall’s Hollow, a small and unassuming Appalachian town. Its story follows two young teenage friends, an american redstart named Dani Resdrin and a grey wolf named Jonah Baeler. 

The story begins as Dani hurries to find Jonah after receiving a concerning text message from the wolf, implying that Jonah is considering taking his own life on that very night. But still, even as Dani races through the darkened streets, the question lingers…

Even if he does make it in time… what happens next?

And will anything still be the same afterwards? 

[From [url=https://rikoh-the-bat.itch.io/night-drive]Itch.io[/url]]
